title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Blueberry
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Keep your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K device running with the Blueberry Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus a 10ml refill container, together delivering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent flavour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod and refill system offers a simple and reliable way to enjoy vaping with the Dojo Blast kit, supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology. Blueberry focuses on the pure, uncomplicated taste of ripe orchard fruit. The profile offers a deep and juicy sweetness that captures the natural essence of fresh Blueberries. With subtle earthy undertones and a soft, rounded finish, it provides a smooth and satisfying vape that is perfect for all-day use. With transparent pods and a clean refill system, managing e-liquid levels is straightforward and fuss-free.
